title: arctium karatavicum
intro: Arctium karatavicum, commonly known as the lesser burdock, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family. The lesser burdock has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural diuretic. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for the treatment of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of the lesser burdock plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
